verdict.rationale: Godot has extensive first-party docs for GDScript and C# and an object-oriented API (godot-docs-1, godot-docs-2, godot-docs-8). Community comments describe documentation as "generally good" and point to a large open-source footprint (godot-comm-2, godot-comm-8). However, the evidence also shows a split ecosystem: C# has far fewer examples than GDScript (godot-comm-5), and users juggle Godot 3.x LTS versus 4.x (godot-comm-10), which undercuts the claim of a stable API that models have seen abundant examples of. Missing for 10: any direct evidence of LLM first-try code success, documented API stability across major versions, evidence of abundant public example corpora, and AI-oriented doc formats (llms.txt and .md mirrors both 404, per godot-probe-1 and godot-probe-2).
